flashcard_questions.q: How many steel flats stood at the back of the Rise Up set?
What did the steel flats represent in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: The Greyhound bus, with rivet holes for windows.

flashcard_questions.q: Why were the steel flats made of reflective silver?
flashcard_questions.a: So the audience could reflect on their own behaviour.

flashcard_questions.q: What was revealed when the steel flats were turned round at the end?
flashcard_questions.a: Real photographs of the real Freedom Riders, yellowed with age.

flashcard_questions.q: What did the actors draw on the flats in red chalk?
flashcard_questions.a: The Freedom Riders’ route, resembling a heartbeat monitor.

flashcard_questions.q: How many stools were used in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: Four — two small and two tall.

flashcard_questions.q: How did the stools create a prison in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: They were turned upside down so the legs suggested prison bars.

flashcard_questions.q: Which prop identified Governor Patterson in Rise Up?
What did the single white gloves show about the White shoppers?
flashcard_questions.a: That they were “as one”, with aligned racist thinking.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Ray Charles song was used in Rise Up?
What lighting showed the bus catching fire in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: An orange shaft of light increasing in intensity.

flashcard_questions.q: Why was Uncle George always positioned stage left?
flashcard_questions.a: To imply he was not an honest or genuine character.

flashcard_questions.q: Where was the Little White Girl usually positioned in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: Stage right, reinforcing her kind, questioning nature.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Dayz’s black and white dress symbolise?
flashcard_questions.a: Two races striving for equality, and that racism is simply right or wrong.

flashcard_questions.q: Which evaluation phrase would introduce a suggested development?
flashcard_questions.a: “I feel that this could have been developed because…”

notes: 15 cards: 7 set and prop design→meaning, 3 causal, 2 staging positions, 1 sound attribution, 1 lighting state, 1 evaluation phrase. The SEAS worked example and the thumbs rule were left out as essay-writing method; the four individual actor costumes were reduced to the white gloves and Dayz’s dress, the two details the lesson develops.
